exams.source_structure: The unique edition-specific preparation heading precedes three content groups. Each group has an h3 naming the domain, an h4 repeating that domain followed by ' Potential Exam Topics:', a bulleted list, a decorated percentage and line break before 'Exam Weight'. Resource accordions follow each weight; practice links and registration follow the final group. No corresponding agreement has to be inferred from the page navigation or hidden HTML.

The accepted snapshot's old table/control labels and appended practice prompts are omitted in the new named-card projection.
